preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(si) <= 10**5 for si in s)
preconditions.description: Each string si has a length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The sum of the lengths of all strings does not exceed 100,000.
Each string si consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of strings in the found subgroup is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s[j].endswith(s[i]) for j in range(i+1, n)) for i in range(return_value-1))
postconditions.description: Each string in the found subgroup is a suffix of the next string in the subgroup.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(s[j].endswith(s[i]) for j in range(i+1, n)) for i in range(return_value, n))
postconditions.description: No larger subgroup satisfies the conditions.
